pipeline_name: OpenAIRE software to GitHub repository dataset

stages.name: read_openaire_software_records
stages.operation: Stream JSON-lines software records from members of the OpenAIRE software archive.

stages.name: select_records_with_code_repository_url
stages.operation: Keep track of records where the OpenAIRE codeRepositoryUrl field is present.

stages.name: filter_github_repositories
stages.operation: Accept only codeRepositoryUrl values whose host is github.com and which can be parsed as OWNER/REPO.

stages.name: normalize_github_repository_urls
stages.operation: Normalize GitHub references to https://github.com/OWNER/REPO; remove .git and deep-link path components.

stages.name: deduplicate_by_normalized_repository_url
stages.operation: Case-insensitive deduplication by normalized GitHub repository URL while preserving the OpenAIRE IDs associated with each repo.

separation_of_concerns.rule: Shared CSV files contain no manual labels. Validation samples and manual annotations must be derived separately from github_repositories.csv.
